connector.name: Packwright MCP
connector.registryDescription: Packwright compiles, renders, validates, and captures paired Minecraft Java packs.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package packwright-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the rithwikbabu account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: PACKWRIGHT_WORKSPACE
env.description: Absolute path containing datapacks and optional sibling resource packs Packwright may access.

env.name: PACKWRIGHT_JAVA
env.description: Optional Java 25 executable used for setup, vanilla command validation, builds, GameTest runs, and official-client visual capture.

env.name: PACKWRIGHT_CACHE_DIR
env.description: Optional absolute path for verified Minecraft artifacts, visual generation runs, client-capture evidence, and local reference data.

env.name: PACKWRIGHT_READ_ONLY
env.description: Set to true to disable MCP tools that write to the workspace.

env.name: PACKWRIGHT_OFFLINE
env.description: Set to true to prohibit network access, including explicit version setup.

env.name: PACKWRIGHT_SPYGLASS_COMMAND
env.description: Optional command for an independently installed and trusted Spyglass executable.
